founder_statement: Saya mengesahkan arsitektur yang sebenarnya sudah kita bangun dan buktikan: Mission Control menjadi traffic controller resmi perusahaan, bukan Hermes.
normalized_effect: Mission Control is ratified as DIE's single deterministic operational control/enforcement plane under the COS-002 packet.
hermes_effect: Hermes loses unique operational-control-plane primacy and remains only in evidence-backed delegated specialist/compatibility roles under OPS-002.
effective_condition: COS-004 applies and validates the ratified canonical governance changes.
